families.rule: Native event effects once; mirrors only correlated. Declared ProtocolFeeSwept must not be assumed emitted: actual buy protocol cut is transferred to Treasury inline during recordFee.

families.primary: Native ERC20 Transfer/Approval and ERC721 Transfer/Approval/ApprovalForAll from registered token family
families.rule: Decode same Transfer topic by emitting standard and indexed layout; balances from actual recipients, not tx origin or trader. Zero address denotes mint/burn.
Beacon emits Upgraded from beacon address; Pausable emits PauseToggled(bool), not Paused/Unpaused. Registry and implementation identity scoped by activation block.
TrackerCallFailed means enrichment missing, not failed native receipt; route and underlying pool legs correlate without duplicate wallet execution.
OrderExecutionFailed is not filled or terminal by itself; activate is not execute; expiry refund is distinct from user cancel.
Reserve state change is not an additional deposit; native PAX and wrapped PAX are separate asset identities.
